svg.title: F-Engine
svg.desc: Host boundary: F-Engine owns versioned contracts and deterministic reel-engine behavior. The host owns auth, persistence, providers, UI, branding, and ops. Demo path needs no accounts. Verify with lint, test, build, package-consumer, and Playwright.
